versions.name: Floodwood Trek Camp
versions.address: Floodwood Road Tupper Lake, New York 12986

features.note: A campfire site overlooking West Pine Pond.
Multi-day hiking treks, including trips into the High Peaks.
Hot showers in the shower house at base camp.
Canoe treks launch from Rollins Pond into the linked Saranac, St Regis, Tupper, Raquette and Fulton Chain waters; the camp keeps a small fleet of lightweight Kevlar canoes.
Staffed by a camp health officer.
The camp is dedicated to trek-based high adventure; each trek carries a trained staff Voyager guide.
Includes a one-mile climb to the top of Floodwood Mountain.
Patrol sites with canvas tents on wood platforms.
Climbing and rappelling on a natural rock face with certified staff instruction.
Two-man saw, fire building and pioneering activities at base camp.
Towed tubing and water skiing on Rollins Pond.
Rollins Pond serves as the launching point for canoe treks and towed water sports.
